newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-MILAN V JUVENTUS TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-MILAN V JUVENTUS TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Sunday's Serie A match between AC Milan and Juventus at the San Siro:

Milan - 1-Sebastiano Rossi, 3-Paolo Maldini, 14-Michael Reiziger, 6-Franco Baresi, 29-Pietro Vierchowod, 34-Jesper Blomqvist, 20-Zvonimir Boban, 8-Marcel Desailly, 10-Dejan Savicevic, 23-Marco Simone, 19-Cristophe Dugarry

Juventus - 1-Angelo Peruzzi, 6-Manuel Dimas, 5-Sergio Porrini, 2-Ciro Ferrara, 13-Mark Iuliano, 7-Angelo Di Livio, 20-Alessio Tacchinardi, 21-Zinedine Zidane, 18-Vladimir Jugovic, 9-Alen Boksic, 15-Christian Vieri
